notes: Soupçon Salon: all 480 listed events plus 159 unlisted event ids were fetched; unlisted ids were drafts or duplicates only. Wayback CDX added nothing beyond what the live site still shows (its event pages stay up after the date). Left out as solo, DJ or open-mic acts: Bill Nace, Christian Mirande, Apologist, Ankylosaurus, Jair-Rohm Parker Wells, Jake Latakas Orrall, Frank Hurricane, Tracy Trance, Kilynn Lunsford, Dave Smolen, Matt Simon, Kimberleigh Rose, Brandon Anthony (solo), Flux in a Constant State (Matt Hurley), Ron Schneiderman, Matt Krefting, King Darves, Mike Polizze, Chris Lyons, Dani Sundream, Clover Stieve, Sweet Pete, Rachel Rosemarie, Ollie Thrice, Nikki Nailbomb, Brook Pridemore, Kailey Rocker, Mandy Valentine, Emily Robb, Jasper Lee, Rich Cahill, the electronic Knob Night producers (iff, chad rulette, evantr0nic, data_wolf, paul.giess), Edley O'Dowd, Rodney Omen, John Patrick Starling, Drew Davis, M. Sidnam, the SoupSTOCK solo slots, the Forever King Clark / Karsyn Wagner / Leah Thompson / Jess Ruiz songwriters, and all DJs. Also left out: Friday open mics, Bucket-o-Jams, NoFi-NJ Avant Mic, drag shows, dance parties, rehearsals, and the Feb 22 2026 Whip Appeal show, which was canceled for snow. Many noise and experimental names (e.g. NaOCl, Spandex Model, Oldest Sea, Ecology Homestones, PCRV, Viator, MJE, DDU, Cofounder, Petite Mort, Body Garden, Stroboseth, MSDS, Splooge Receptacle, Enjoy Being, Earth-Rim Walker, Jewel Eye) may be one-person projects; they were kept because they have act names. Two run-on titles were split by guesswork: Jul 4 2025 into Slime / Outdoor Horse Shrine / Slow Tongued Beauty / MJE / DDU / Cofounder / Petite Mort, and Jul 22 2026 into Slime Queen / Bingo Breakdancing / Ronald Reagan? The Actor? / Death Envy. Spelling variants were merged: Meter/Meteor Police, Bloodmoons/Blood Moons, Wholewheat/Whole Wheat, [Exhibit: A]/Exhibit A, Markie Model/Markiemodel, and Brandon Anthony and Andy Dreamos = Brandyn Andyny. TBA slots and bills listed only as 'bands TBA' are not filled in. Some site times show AM by mistake (e.g. 7:00AM); the body text was used where it gives a time. RRAT Club is a promoter collective ('River Radical Art Team', Lumberville PA PO box), not a venue. Its 5 known shows came from the Soupçon calendar. The rratclub.com Wix site is unpublished, the Instagram grid has no readable dates, and about 8 web searches found nothing else (no Facebook, Bandcamp or Songkick hits). Other promoters seen on the calendar: DRC (Delaware River Crew), Foul Depths, Order of the Winking Star, House Of The Model. Extra fields per appearance: bill (other bands that night), time, price, billing, presenter.
